auto_click.name: Auto-click
auto_click.description: Enable the diagnostic cube hazard scanner. It estimates arrival in physics frames; it does not send clicks.

auto_jump.name: Experimental cube auto-jump
auto_jump.description: Test only: queues one jump when the cube is grounded and a hazard is inside the correction window. Disabled by default; timing is not yet validated.

correction_frames.name: Correction window
correction_frames.description: Target window for the experimental cube jump test (2–10 physics frames).
